newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HOLLAND COLOURS IN JAPANESE JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: HOLLAND COLOURS IN JAPANESE JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Ink- and pigments maker Holland Colours NV said on Tuesday it would set up a joint venture in Japan called HCA-Japan.
The unit will be 60 percent owned by Holland Colours, with Japan's Kikuchi Color & Chemicals Corp holding the remaining 40 percent.

Holland Colours said the jointly owned firm would launch its products on the Japanese market and would be operational from July 1. Kikuchi would supply its marketing and sales know-how to the joint venture.
"By introducing Holland Colours products in the Japanese market, one of the last blank spots of the world map for industrial markets will be filled," the Dutch group said in a statement.
Holland Colours said earlier its net profit for the financial year to March 31, 1997, had risen by 29 percent to 5.55 million guilders. Turnover grew by 18 percent to 91 million.
